title: [Extensibility Request] issue 30351: extend OnCheckExpirationDateOnBeforeAssignExpirationDate event
summary: The OnCheckExpirationDateOnBeforeAssignExpirationDate event gains three new parameters (GlobalItemTrackingCode, ItemJnlLine2, SignFactor) to allow subscribers to access the data needed for expiration date assignment logic.
key_points: Event now exposes the item tracking code, journal line, and sign factor
Enables subscribers to replicate expiration-date assignment logic using the IsHandled pattern
Change applied consistently across W1 and all country-specific layers
